newsitem.title: USA: Knight-Ridder May operating revs up 4.7 pct. [CORRECTED 00:22 GMT 24/6]
newsitem.headline: Knight-Ridder May operating revs up 4.7 pct. [CORRECTED 00:22 GMT 24/6]

text.p: Knight Ridder Inc said Monday its operating revenue for May was up 4.7 percent compared with the same month last year and for the year-to-date.

A company spokeswoman said operating revenue rose a little more than $15 million for May and about $75 million for the year-to-date (corrects to show the figures as increases rather than the operating revenue themselves).
It said the comparisons exclude Knight-Ridder Financial, which was sold in July 1996, and four newspapers of Walt Disney Co which were acquired May 9.
